subject: Executive Office Reorganization and Personnel Ordinance Amendments
overview: The Council approved first readings for a significant reorganization of the Mayor's executive office and established a subcommittee to study the Malden Hospital redevelopment. Members also addressed recurring complaints regarding taxi accessibility, school department communication, and construction impacts on businesses near the Craddock Bridge.

items.title: Solicitor Identification Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution reinforcing the ordinance requiring door-to-door solicitors to register with the City Clerk and wear identification due to neighborhood break-ins.

items.title: Executive Office Reorganization and Reclassification
items.summary: Approved first readings for ordinance amendments establishing a Chief of Staff and Policy position, a Chief Procurement Officer, and adjusting terms for the City Solicitor. Discussion focused on the Chief of Staff's $106,000 salary and a potential legal conflict involving the City Auditor assuming Treasurer-Collector duties.

items.title: Malden Hospital Reuse Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved the establishment of an ad hoc subcommittee to study the impacts of the Malden Hospital development on North Medford neighborhoods. The Council requested updates on traffic mitigation and similar developments in neighboring Stoneham.

items.title: Taxi Licensing Reform
items.summary: Referred a proposal to transfer taxi licensing authority from the City Council to the Traffic Commission to the Licensing Subcommittee. Public comment highlighted the need for ADA-accessible vehicles and better enforcement of service dog laws.

items.title: School Public Relations Communication
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the school department establish a voicemail system and clear job description for the new public relations position after reports of unreturned calls. A local business owner testified regarding failed attempts to coordinate an after-school program.

items.title: Customer Service and 311 Implementation
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting updates on customer service training and the implementation of the 311 'SeeClickFix' system. The Council requested training for members on the new platform to better assist constituents with service requests.

items.title: Common Victualler License Approvals
items.summary: Approved a license for Iris Family Restaurant at 432 Salem Street and processed a memorial resolution and routine meeting minutes.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Construction Impact
items.summary: Scheduled a Committee of the Whole meeting for January 27 to address the Department of Transportation's lack of response regarding construction barriers harming local businesses. The City Solicitor advised exploring all administrative avenues before pursuing a work stoppage via litigation.
